redaction: Redacted copy: a user folder, name or email is replaced by <user>, <name> or <email> in text, or covered by a box in a picture; nothing else changed.
scope: Full current root after portable-handoff repair, native custody/regression, original media owner, visual freshness, concept and handoff gates. First root failure retained. No app/source-server/runtime/installer changes or stage acceptance.

rawLog.normalization: LF and trailing horizontal whitespace in readable companion only; exact original process bytes retained.
